{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Nebalite]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Grazdoc]] owned a small '''starship''' that he used while operating in a [[Unidentified Unknown Regions sector|sector]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], like those of other Nebalites, was constructed around Grazdoc's body, was equipped with [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] capabilities, and had additional room for the trader's small [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[X-17-D]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
